title: Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture for Expertise-Adaptive Qualitative Interviews Using Local LLMs

paragraphs.en: Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture for Expertise-Adaptive Qualitative Interviews Using Local LLMs
paragraphs.zh: 基于本地大型语言模型、具备证据可追溯性的动态访谈架构：面向专业适应性定性访谈的智能体设计

paragraphs.en: Automated interviewers and conversational agents are increasingly used in research, recruitment, customer service, and education. However, many existing systems rely on fixed question sequences and provide limited context-based personalization without considering participants’ knowledge, which can lead to repetitive or irrelevant follow-up questions. Therefore, there is a need for an adaptive interviewing system that can adjust question depth while maintaining conversational continuity and semantic progression. To address this, an Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture is presented using a locally hosted Large Language Model (LLM), with the interview continuously adapted throughout the entire conversation based on the participant’s responses and evolving context. The interviewer profiles participants’ expertise in real time to generate knowledge-appropriate questions, well-articulated responses, and smooth transition messages that support conversational continuity. A five-module prompt-driven architecture and persistent interview-state record support these functions. The interviewer was evaluated with 246 participants. Expertise Profiling module (M3) showed 78.9% exact agreement with independently reported participant expertise, with a weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.80. Generate Iterative Questions module (M4) showed a strong expertise-complexity association ( ρ = .79 , p < .001 \rho=.79,p<.001 ), and participants reported high relevance (mean 4.41), engagement (mean 4.32), and satisfaction (mean 4.38), providing evidence that the architecture’s adaptive components operated consistently with their intended functions while participants reported a positive interview experience.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化面试官和对话智能体正越来越多地应用于研究、招聘、客户服务和教育领域。 然而，许多现有系统依赖固定的问题序列，且仅提供有限的上下文个性化功能，并未考虑参与者的知识水平，这可能导致重复或无关的后续问题。 因此，有必要开发一种自适应采访系统，能够在保持对话连贯性和语义推进的同时调整问题的深度。 为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种证据可追溯的动态面试官架构，该系统使用本地部署的大语言模型（LLM），并基于参与者的回答和不断变化的上下文在整个对话过程中持续调整采访流程。 该面试官能够实时分析参与者的专业水平，生成与知识水平匹配的问题、表述清晰的回答以及支持对话连贯性的流畅过渡信息。 一种由五个模块组成的提示驱动架构和持久的采访状态记录支持了这些功能。 该面试官通过 246 名参与者进行了评估。 专业水平分析模块（M3）与参与者独立报告的专业水平实现了 78.9% 的完全一致，加权 Cohen’s κ \kappa 值为 0.80。 迭代问题生成模块（M4）展现出强烈的专业水平与问题复杂度相关性（ρ = .79, p < .001 \rho=.79,p<.001），参与者报告了高度的相关性（均值 4.41）、参与度（均值 4.32）和满意度（均值 4.38），这表明该架构的自适应组件与其预期功能保持一致，同时参与者也反馈了积极的采访体验。

paragraphs.en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to support human–machine interaction in customer service, education, recruitment, and research [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Conversational agents and automated interviewers can reduce the effort required for repeated interactions, improve consistency, and support open-ended information elicitation [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] . However, many existing systems still rely on predefined questions, rule-based dialogue structures, or limited intent-recognition mechanisms, restricting their ability to generate follow-up questions that respond to participants’ statements, explore emerging topics, while adapting to differences in knowledge and experience [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地用于支持客户服务、教育、招聘和研究领域的人机互动 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。 对话智能体和自动化面试官可以减少重复互动所需的工作量，提高一致性，并支持开放式的信息获取 [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] 。 然而，许多现有系统仍然依赖预定义的问题、基于规则的对话结构或有限的意图识别机制，这限制了它们生成后续问题的能力——这些后续问题本应回应参与者的陈述、探索新兴话题，并适应知识与经验上的差异 [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) provide greater flexibility by interpreting conversational context and dynamically generating questions without relying entirely on hard-coded templates [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . This is particularly relevant to qualitative interviewing, where participants differ in their familiarity with the topic and in the depth of discussion they can engage in. Participants with limited knowledge may require accessible, experience-based questions, whereas those demonstrating greater expertise can engage with more analytical, comparative, or evaluative questions. Natural-language responses can provide evidence for estimating evolving expertise [ 11 ] , and recent LLM-based interviewing studies demonstrate the feasibility of adaptive, context-sensitive follow-up questioning [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . However, context-sensitive generation alone does not ensure expertise-appropriate questioning or prevent semantic repetition across interview turns. LLM interaction can also produce irrelevant or unsupported outputs, inconsistent dialogue progression, hallucinations, and privacy risks [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）通过解读对话语境并动态生成问题，无需完全依赖硬编码模板，从而提供了更大的灵活性 [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] 。 这一点在定性访谈中尤为重要，因为参与者的主题熟悉程度和讨论深度各不相同。 知识有限的参与者可能需要通俗易懂、基于经验的问题，而表现出更高专业水平的参与者则可以应对更具分析性、比较性或评估性的问题。 自然语言回应可以为评估不断发展的专业水平提供依据 [ 11 ] ，而近期基于 LLM 的访谈研究也证明了自适应、语境敏感的后续提问是可行的 [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] 。 然而，仅靠语境敏感的生成机制并不能确保问题与专业水平相匹配，也无法避免访谈不同回合中的语义重复。 LLM 互动也可能产生无关或无依据的输出、不一致的对话推进、幻觉以及隐私风险 [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Privacy is particularly important in qualitative interviewing because participant responses may contain personal, contextual, organizational, or otherwise sensitive information. Processing such responses through externally hosted LLM services may require interview data to leave the researcher’s controlled computing environment. Local LLM deployment provides a privacy-preserving alternative by enabling inference to be performed within locally controlled infrastructure and reducing the need to transmit raw participant responses to external services [ 23 , 7 ] . Previous studies have demonstrated the use of local LLMs for context-aware anonymization of sensitive qualitative data and privacy-conscious AI-powered interviewing, while resource-efficient prompt design has shown that local deployment can remain computationally practical even under constrained hardware conditions [ 23 , 7 , 19 ] . Effective adaptive interviewing therefore requires structured mechanisms for controlling interview behavior, inferring expertise, adapting question complexity, maintaining conversational continuity, and validating generated questions. These are supported by structured prompting, controlled adaptation, output validation, and local deployment [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在定性访谈中，隐私尤为重要，因为参与者的回答可能包含个人、情境、组织或其他敏感信息。 通过外部托管的大型语言模型（LLM）服务处理此类回答，可能需要将访谈数据带出研究人员的受控计算环境。 本地部署大型语言模型（LLM）提供了一种保护隐私的替代方案，它允许在本地受控的基础设施内执行推理，并减少将原始参与者回答传输至外部服务的必要性 [ 23 , 7 ] 。 先前的研究已经证明了使用本地大型语言模型（LLM）对敏感定性数据进行情境感知匿名化以及进行注重隐私的 AI 驱动访谈的可能性，同时资源高效的提示设计表明，即使在硬件条件受限的情况下，本地部署仍然可以在计算上保持可行性 [ 23 , 7 , 19 ] 。 因此，有效的自适应访谈需要结构化的机制来控制访谈行为、推断专业水平、调整问题复杂度、维持对话的连贯性，并验证生成的问题。 这些需求可通过结构化提示、受控适应、输出验证和本地部署来实现 [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, this study proposes an Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture for adaptive qualitative interviewing using a locally hosted LLM. The study examines whether an AI-powered interviewer can infer participants’ demonstrated expertise from their responses, use the inferred expertise to adjust subsequent question complexity, maintain contextually relevant and semantically non-repetitive questioning, and provide a positive interview experience. The architecture is designed so that the relationship between participant responses, inferred expertise, generated questions, and validation decisions can be examined throughout the interview process.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，本研究提出了一种基于本地部署的大型语言模型（LLM）的证据可追溯动态访谈者架构，用于实现自适应定性访谈。 本研究旨在探究：由人工智能驱动的访谈者能否从参与者的回答中推断出其展现的专业能力，能否利用推断出的专业能力调整后续问题的复杂程度，能否保持问题在语境上的相关性和语义上的非重复性，并能否提供积极的访谈体验。 该架构的设计使得在整个访谈过程中，能够考察参与者回答、推断出的专业能力、生成的问题以及验证决策之间的相互关系。

paragraphs.en: Consequently, the study addresses the following research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 因此，本研究探讨了以下研究问题：

paragraphs.en: How effectively can an AI-powered interviewer infer participants’ expertise from their responses and use the derived expertise to adapt subsequent question complexity?
paragraphs.zh: 由人工智能驱动的面试官能多有效地从参与者的回答中推断出其专业水平，并利用推断出的专业水平来调整后续问题的难度？

paragraphs.en: How does the proposed architecture support contextually relevant and semantically non-repetitive questioning throughout an interview?
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的架构如何支持在整个访谈过程中提出与上下文相关且语义上无重复的问题？

paragraphs.en: How do participants evaluate the relevance, engagement, and overall experience of dynamically generated AI-powered interviews?
paragraphs.zh: 参与者如何评估动态生成的、由人工智能驱动访谈的相关性、互动性以及整体体验？

paragraphs.en: The study contributes a modular, prompt-driven, and evidence-traceable AI-powered interviewer that dynamically adjusts question complexity according to demonstrated participant expertise. It also provides a structured mechanism for generating contextually relevant, non-redundant, and semantically coherent interview dialogue using locally hosted LLM. Finally, the architecture is empirically evaluated using 246 participant interviews, examining expertise agreement, expertise-driven question adaptation, semantic question uniqueness, and participant perceptions of relevance, engagement, and overall satisfaction.

paragraphs.en: Conversational systems have increasingly been used for surveys and interviews. Studies show that conversational interfaces can improve engagement, response quality, social presence, and self-disclosure in comparison to conventional questionnaires [ 2 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] . Interview-specific systems have extended this work through active listening, participant profiling, and automatic follow-up questioning [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 33 ] . However, these approaches mainly adapt to conversational context or probing needs and rarely maintain an explicit, continuously updated representation of the participant’s demonstrated expertise.

sents.en: Studies show that conversational interfaces can improve engagement, response quality, social presence, and self-disclosure in comparison to conventional questionnaires [ 2 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] .

paragraphs.en: LLMs have further increased the flexibility of automated interviewing by enabling dynamic and context-sensitive question generation. Studies have shown that LLM interviewers can support scalable qualitative interviewing, generate useful probes, collect in-the-moment feedback, manage conversational goals, and maintain participant engagement [ 8 , 10 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] . However, their performance varies across models and interview situations. Problems include inappropriate follow-ups, weak acknowledgment, limited strategic progression toward deeper questions, and variations in relevance and naturalness [ 9 , 31 , 32 ] . These findings show that fluent question generation alone is insufficient; an interviewer must also control when to probe, how deeply to probe, and how questions should respond to the participant’s demonstrated capability.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 通过实现动态且基于上下文的提问生成，进一步提升了自动化访谈的灵活性。 研究表明，LLM 访谈员能够支持可扩展的定性访谈、生成有效的探问、收集即时反馈、管理对话目标，并维持参与者的参与度 [ 8 , 10 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] 。 然而，不同模型和访谈情境下，其表现存在差异。 存在的问题包括不当的后续追问、回应不够充分、向更深层问题推进的策略性不足，以及相关性和自然度的差异 [ 9 , 31 , 32 ] 。 这些发现表明，仅能流畅生成问题是远远不够的；访谈员还必须掌控何时进行探问、探问的深度，以及问题应如何根据参与者表现出的能力作出回应。

paragraphs.en: A key requirement for such adaptation is modeling user expertise. Research on adaptive systems shows that expertise can be inferred from observable behavior and represented as an evolving user state [ 34 , 35 , 38 , 39 ] . Expert–novice research further shows that experts reason using deeper principles, while novices rely more on surface characteristics [ 36 ] . The expertise-reversal literature also indicates that interaction suitable for inexperienced users may become ineffective for more knowledgeable users [ 37 ] . These findings support adapting question complexity according to evidence such as terminology, conceptual correctness, reasoning depth, and application or evaluative reasoning, instead of relying only on technical vocabulary.
paragraphs.zh: 实现此类自适应的一个关键要求是建模用户的专家水平。 关于自适应系统的研究表明，专家水平可以从可观察的行为中推断出来，并表现为一个不断演化的用户状态 [ 34 , 35 , 38 , 39 ] 。 专家与新手相关的研究进一步表明，专家运用更深层的原理进行推理，而新手则更多依赖表面特征 [ 36 ] 。 关于“专家水平逆转”的文献也指出，适合经验不足用户的交互方式可能对知识更丰富的用户变得无效 [ 37 ] 。 这些发现支持根据术语、概念正确性、推理深度以及应用或评价性推理等证据来调整问题的复杂程度，而不是仅依赖专业词汇。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive interviewing must also maintain conversational continuity. Active-listening research highlights the importance of acknowledging participant responses, while studies on adaptive and motivational interviewing emphasize contextual awareness, relevance, openness, and natural transitions [ 31 , 32 ] . This supports separating interviewer output into a Response Message, Transition Message, and Next Question , allowing acknowledgement, conversational flow, and information elicitation to be controlled as distinct but connected functions.
paragraphs.zh: 适应性访谈还必须保持对话的连贯性。 积极倾听的研究凸显了认可参与者回应的重要性，而关于适应性和激励性访谈的研究则强调了情境意识、相关性、开放性和自然过渡 [ 31 , 32 ] 。 这支持将访谈者的输出分为「回应信息」「过渡信息」和「下一个问题」，从而能够分别控制认可、对话流程和信息提取，使其成为相互独立但又关联的功能。

paragraphs.en: Another challenge is semantic repetition. Questions may use different wording while asking for essentially the same information. Semantic textual similarity methods such as Sentence-BERT, SimCSE, and sentence meta-embeddings provide mechanisms for identifying conceptual similarity beyond lexical overlap [ 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] . Although these methods are widely used for semantic similarity and duplicate detection, semantic uniqueness is less commonly implemented as an explicit generation gate that can reject a redundant interview question before it reaches the participant.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个挑战是语义重复。 问题可能使用不同的措辞，但实际上是在询问相同的信息。 语义文本相似性方法，例如 Sentence-BERT、SimCSE 和句子元嵌入，提供了识别超越词汇重叠的概念相似性的机制 [ 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] 。 尽管这些方法被广泛用于语义相似性和重复检测，但语义唯一性作为明确的生成门控机制却较少被实施，而这种机制可以在冗余的访谈问题到达参与者之前将其拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Prompt structure is also important for controlling LLM behavior. Structured prompting and semantic structuring pipelines can define task instructions, persistent behavior, memory, reasoning constraints, feedback, and output formats across multi-stage workflows [ 12 , 44 , 45 , 46 , 47 ] . Such control is particularly important because LLM-generated outputs can contain hallucinations, contradictions, or unsupported information [ 14 , 16 , 17 ] . Privacy is also important in LLM-assisted qualitative research because participant responses may contain personal, organizational, or otherwise sensitive information, creating security and privacy considerations for AI-supported research workflows [ 13 , 48 , 49 , 50 ] . Altogether, these concerns support the need for structured prompts, explicit ethical and knowledge-handling rules, and locally deployed models that provide greater control over data processing.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词的结构对于控制大型语言模型（LLM）的行为也至关重要。 结构化提示和语义结构化流程可以定义任务指令、持续行为、记忆、推理约束、反馈以及多阶段工作流程中的输出格式 [ 12 , 44 , 45 , 46 , 47 ] 。 这种控制尤为重要，因为大型语言模型生成的输出可能包含幻觉、矛盾或无依据的信息 [ 14 , 16 , 17 ] 。 在大型语言模型辅助的定性研究中，隐私问题同样重要，因为参与者的回答可能包含个人、组织或其他敏感信息，从而对人工智能支持的研究流程提出安全和隐私方面的考量 [ 13 , 48 , 49 , 50 ] 。 综合来看，这些关注点凸显了结构化提示、明确的伦理与知识处理规则，以及能够更有效地控制数据处理的本地部署模型的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Overall, existing research has advanced conversational surveys, adaptive probing, LLM interviewing, expertise modeling, semantic similarity, and structured prompting. However, these capabilities are generally studied separately. Expertise models describe changing user knowledge [ 36 , 38 , 39 ] , while LLM interviewers mainly adapt to conversational context [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] . Semantic-similarity methods identify conceptual overlap [ 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] , and structured prompting provides mechanisms for controlling LLM tasks [ 24 , 44 , 45 , 46 , 47 ] . What remains limited is their integration into a single interviewing process that generates semantically unique interview questions and connects participant responses to expertise estimation so that the complexity of subsequent questions is adapted while maintaining conversational continuity.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，现有研究推动了对话式调查、自适应探测、大型语言模型（LLM）访谈、专家能力建模、语义相似性和结构化提示的发展。 然而，这些能力通常被分别研究。 专家能力模型描述了用户知识的变化 [ 36 , 38 , 39 ]，而 LLM 访谈者则主要适应对话语境 [ 29 , 30 , 31 ]。 语义相似性方法用于识别概念上的重叠 [ 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ]，而结构化提示则为控制 LLM 任务提供了机制 [ 24 , 44 , 45 , 46 , 47 ]。 目前仍有限的是，如何将这些能力整合到一个统一的访谈流程中，该流程能够生成语义上独特的访谈问题，并将参与者的回答与专家能力评估联系起来，从而在保持对话连贯性的同时调整后续问题的复杂程度。

paragraphs.en: The Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture is designed to conduct adaptive, context-aware, and expertise-aligned qualitative interviews using a modular LLM-based pipeline. The architecture separates the main interviewing functions so that each stage can be independently configured, inspected, and evaluated. It consists of five modules: Generate System Prompt (M1), Generate Initial Question (M2), Expertise Profiling (M3), Generate Iterative Question (M4), and Validate Question Uniqueness (M5).
paragraphs.zh: 证据可追溯的动态访谈者架构旨在通过模块化的大语言模型（LLM）流程，执行适应性、上下文感知且与专业领域对齐的定性访谈。 该架构将主要访谈功能进行分离，使得每个阶段都能独立配置、检查与评估。 它由五个模块组成：生成系统提示（M1）、生成初始问题（M2）、专家画像分析（M3）、生成迭代问题（M4）以及验证问题唯一性（M5）。

paragraphs.en: Module 1 establishes the interview environment by transforming the design-time interview configuration into a structured system prompt that governs the complete interview session. The system prompt is generated once and reused by M2–M5, providing a consistent behavioral foundation throughout the interaction.

paragraphs.en: These factors also support design-level traceability. Important prompt constraints can be linked to their purpose and supporting rationale. For example, restrictions on unsupported information address LLM hallucination, while privacy and sensitive-question controls support ethical handling of participant data. The evidence/source registry therefore records why important factors were included without requiring research citations to be repeatedly inserted into the interview prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 这些因素也有助于实现设计层面的可追溯性。 重要的提示词约束条件可以与它们的目的及支持依据相关联。 例如，对不支持信息的限制可以应对大语言模型的幻觉问题，而隐私和敏感问题控制则有助于以合乎伦理的方式处理参与者数据。 因此，证据/来源登记册会记录重要因素被纳入的原因，而无需将研究引用反复插入访谈提示词中。

paragraphs.en: Module 3 dynamically estimates the participant’s demonstrated expertise from their responses and provides this information to M4 to control the depth and complexity of subsequent questions. Expertise is classified into four levels: Novice, Basic Knowledge, Advanced Knowledge, and Expert . The classification is based on four observable factors: domain terminology and specificity (F1), conceptual correctness and relevance (F2), reasoning depth (F3), and application or evaluative reasoning (F4) .

paragraphs.en: The adaptive behavior of M4 is controlled primarily by the expertise information generated by M3. Lower demonstrated expertise leads to clearer and less technically demanding questions, while higher expertise supports deeper analytical, comparative, scenario-based, or evaluative questioning. Expertise does not determine the question alone. M4 also considers what the participant has already discussed, which research areas remain insufficiently explored, and whether clarification, elaboration, examples, comparison, reflection, or deeper reasoning would best advance the interview.
paragraphs.zh: M4 的自适应行为主要由 M3 生成的专业度信息所控制。 表现出的专业度较低时，提出的问题会更清晰且技术难度更低；而较高的专业度则支持更深入的分析性、比较性、情景化或评估性问题。 专业度并非唯一决定问题的因素。 M4 还会考虑参与者已讨论的内容、哪些研究领域尚未得到充分探索，以及澄清、详细阐述、举例、比较、反思或更深入的推理中，哪种方式最有助于推进访谈。

paragraphs.en: The case study investigated how employees interact with Large Language Models (LLMs) in the workplace . paragraphs.en: Participants were recruited through university and professional networks and were required to be at least 18 years old with workplace experience. Participation was voluntary, and informed consent was obtained electronically before the interview. Participants were informed about the study purpose, data handling, confidentiality, and their right to withdraw at any time. Each participant followed the same general flow, while the actual sequence and complexity of questions could vary according to their responses and dynamically estimated expertise.

paragraphs.en: Each generated follow-up question was therefore associated with both the M3 expertise level assigned for the corresponding interview turn and a question-complexity score from 1 to 4. For participant-level analysis, the complexity scores of the adaptive follow-up questions were aggregated to obtain a mean question-complexity score for each participant. This avoided treating multiple questions generated for the same participant as independent observations. The relationship between M3 expertise and question complexity was evaluated using Spearman’s rank correlation, since both expertise and question complexity represent ordered levels. Mean question-complexity scores were also examined across the four M3 expertise categories to determine whether question depth increased systematically from Novice to Expert. The complexity classifications were independently assigned by two researchers during post-interview analysis using the four-level criteria defined above. Across the 246 completed interviews, a total of 3,690 adaptive follow-up questions generated by M4 were included in the complexity assessment. Inter-rater reliability was assessed using linearly weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa , since the four complexity categories were ordinal. Percentage agreement was also calculated. Disagreements were reviewed jointly by the two researchers, and a final consensus classification was assigned before the subsequent analysis. M5 provided a separate examination of whether the adapted questions introduced a new information objective or were identified as semantically overlapping with questions already asked. Its validation history was therefore used to examine first-pass acceptance and regeneration decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，每个生成的后续问题都与对应访谈回合中指定的 M3 专业水平以及一个从 1 到 4 的问题复杂度评分相关联。 在参与者层面分析中，将适应性后续问题的复杂度评分汇总，以计算每位参与者的平均问题复杂度评分。 这避免了将同一参与者生成的多个问题视为独立观察值。 由于专业水平和问题复杂度均代表有序等级，因此使用斯皮尔曼等级相关法评估了 M3 专业水平与问题复杂度之间的关系。 还考察了四个 M3 专业水平类别中的平均问题复杂度评分，以确定问题深度是否从“新手”到“专家”呈系统性增加。 在访谈后的分析中，两名研究人员根据上述定义的四级标准独立分配了复杂度分类。 在 246 次完成的访谈中，M4 生成的总共 3,690 个适应性后续问题被纳入了复杂度评估。 由于四个复杂度类别是顺序变量，因此使用线性加权科恩 κ（κ）评估了评分者间信度。 同时计算了百分比一致率。 不一致之处由两名研究人员共同审查，并在后续分析前确定了最终的共识分类。 M5 单独检验了这些改编后的问题是否引入了新的信息目标，或是否与已提出的问题在语义上重叠。 因此，其验证历史被用于考察首次通过接受和再生成决策。

paragraphs.en: The participant characteristics show considerable variation in professional experience and familiarity with LLM technologies. Overall, 64.2% of participants reported using LLMs either daily or weekly, whereas 19.1% reported rarely or never using them. This variation provided a suitable participant population for evaluating an architecture designed to adjust interview questioning according to different levels of demonstrated expertise. Participants also independently reported their perceived level of LLM expertise using the same four categories applied by M3. Based on the participant-reported classifications, 52 participants (21.1%) identified as Novice, 73 (29.7%) as Basic Knowledge, 76 (30.9%) as Advanced Knowledge, and 45 (18.3%) as Expert. These values were collected independently and were not provided to M3 during expertise profiling.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者的特征显示，他们在专业经验和对大型语言模型（LLM）技术的熟悉程度上存在显著差异。 总体而言，64.2%的参与者表示他们每天或每周都会使用LLM，而19.1%的参与者表示他们很少使用或从未使用过。 这种差异使得参与者群体适合评估一种能够根据所展现的不同专业水平调整访谈问题的架构。 参与者还独立地报告了他们自认为的LLM专业水平，并使用了M3所采用的相同四个分类。 根据参与者报告的分类，有52名参与者（21.1%）自认为是新手，73人（29.7%）是基础知识水平，76人（30.9%）是高级知识水平，45人（18.3%）是专家水平。 这些数值是独立收集的，在专业水平评估过程中并未提供给M3。

paragraphs.en: The next evaluation examined whether the expertise levels inferred by M3 were reflected in the questions subsequently generated by M4. Follow-up questions were classified into four ordinal cognitive-complexity levels: accessible/descriptive (1), explanatory or example-based (2), analytical or comparative (3), and evaluative, scenario-based, or application-oriented (4). Inter-rater reliability for the question-complexity classifications was high. The two researchers achieved 89.1% exact agreement across the 3,690 independently classified follow-up questions, with a linearly weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.86. Most disagreements involved adjacent complexity levels and were resolved through discussion before the final classifications were used in the subsequent analysis.

paragraphs.en: A clear increase in question complexity was observed with increasing expertise. Questions generated for Novice participants primarily requested descriptions, experiences, or straightforward examples. Basic Knowledge participants received more explanatory and application-oriented questions. Advanced Knowledge participants were increasingly asked to analyze relationships, compare alternatives, and consider risks, while Expert participants more frequently received scenario-based and evaluative questions requiring justification, assessment of trade-offs, or proposals for technical and organizational controls.

paragraphs.en: Question relevance and coherence received the highest mean score ( M = 4.41 M=4.41 , S ​ D = 0.58 SD=0.58 ), indicating that participants generally perceived the dynamically generated questions as relevant to their responses and logically connected throughout the interview. Cognitive and emotional engagement was also rated highly ( M = 4.32 M=4.32 , S ​ D = 0.64 SD=0.64 ), suggesting that the adaptive questioning maintained participant involvement. Overall satisfaction was similarly positive ( M = 4.38 M=4.38 , S ​ D = 0.61 SD=0.61 ). Together with the architecture-level verification, these participant ratings indicate that dynamically adapting question complexity and maintaining semantic progression did not negatively affect the interview experience. Participants generally experienced the interviews as relevant, engaging, and satisfactory while the interviewer adjusted its questioning according to their demonstrated expertise.

paragraphs.en: This study presented an Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture for conducting adaptive qualitative interviews using a locally hosted LLM. The architecture separates the interviewing process into five modules covering system-prompt generation, initial questioning, dynamic expertise profiling, adaptive iterative questioning, and semantic question-uniqueness validation. A persistent interview-state record supports traceability between participant responses, expertise inference, question-generation decisions, and validation outcomes. The architecture was implemented using Llama 3.2 3B and evaluated with 246 participants in a workplace LLM-use case study. The results provide evidence that the evaluated adaptive components operated consistently with their intended functions. M3 achieved 78.9% exact agreement with independently reported participant expertise and 98.4% agreement within one adjacent level, with a linearly weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.80. M4 showed a strong relationship between inferred expertise and subsequent question complexity ( ρ = .79 \rho=.79 , p < .001 p<.001 ). M5 accepted 94.0% of first-pass candidate questions and returned 6.0% for regeneration after identifying semantic overlap. Participants also rated question relevance and coherence ( M = 4.41 M=4.41 ), engagement ( M = 4.32 M=4.32 ), and overall satisfaction ( M = 4.38 M=4.38 ) positively.

paragraphs.en: These findings show that expertise profiling serves a functional role beyond participant classification by influencing the depth and cognitive demand of subsequent questions. M5 further provides a filtering mechanism for identifying potentially repetitive questions before they are presented to participants. Together, response evidence, expertise-aware adaptation, conversational continuity, and semantic validation provide a structured process for moving from a participant’s response to an appropriate next question while retaining an inspectable decision trail.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现表明，专家特征分析除了对参与者进行分类之外，还发挥着功能性作用，因为它会影响后续问题的深度和认知需求。 M5 进一步提供了一种过滤机制，用于在问题呈现给参与者之前识别可能重复的问题。 综合来看，回应证据、基于专家特征的自适应、对话连贯性和语义验证共同构成了一种结构化流程，能够从参与者的回应过渡到适当的下一个问题，同时保留可追溯的决策路径。

paragraphs.en: A limitation of the present study is that the architecture was evaluated using a single local LLM, Llama 3.2 3B. The architecture is conceptually model-independent because its modules and information flow are separated from the underlying LLM; however, the present evaluation does not establish model-independent performance. Different local models may respond differently to the same structured prompts, and cross-model evaluation is therefore required to determine the consistency and robustness of the architecture across model families and parameter sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的一个局限性在于，其架构是使用单个本地 LLM（Llama 3.2 3B）进行评估的。 从概念上讲，该架构是模型无关的，因为其模块和信息流与底层的 LLM 相分离；然而，当前的评估并未证明其性能具有模型无关性。 不同的本地模型可能对相同的结构化提示产生不同的响应，因此需要进行跨模型评估，以确定该架构在不同模型系列和参数规模下的一致性和鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Future work will evaluate the architecture using multiple local LLMs to examine model independence, robustness, and consistency of expertise classification and adaptive questioning. Further studies can apply the architecture to different qualitative research domains, languages, and participant populations. Additional work may investigate longer-term interview memory and integration with downstream qualitative-analysis pipelines, supporting a more complete privacy-conscious workflow for locally executed interview collection and analysis. The modular and evidence-traceable structure presented in this study provides a foundation for developing context-aware, expertise-aligned, non-repetitive, and auditable qualitative interviews.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作将使用多个本地大型语言模型（LLM）来评估该架构，以检验模型独立性、稳健性，以及专业知识分类和自适应提问的一致性。 进一步的研究可以将该架构应用于不同的定性研究领域、语言和参与者群体。 后续工作可能还会研究更长期的访谈记忆功能，以及与下游定性分析流程的集成，从而支持一种更注重隐私保护的完整工作流程，用于本地执行的访谈收集与分析。 本研究提出的模块化且具备证据可追溯性的结构，为开发能够感知上下文、与专业知识对齐、避免重复且可审计的定性访谈提供了基础。
